parameters.name: ApplicationRoleId
parameters.description: The ID of the application role.

parameters.name: ApplicationRoleName
parameters.description: The name of the application role.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You must make sure that the token is unique for each request. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see [How to ensure idempotence](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/ecs/developer-reference/how-to-ensure-idempotence).
